overview: Leather made worth having: rotten flesh smelts into it, leather gear comes apart into scraps and back again, and saddles and horse armor are finally craftable.

2.0.1: Leather and scraps drop from the mobs that carry them again, through the game's own loot shape.
2.0.0: Every recipe brings the advancement that unlocks it.
The client is told what each one is made of.
1.1.1: A leatherworker with lessons to teach: no furnace tells you it will take rotten flesh.
An advancement for your first block of leather.
1.0.0: Rabbit hide becomes Leather Scraps, and rotten flesh smelts down.
Leather items deconstruct into scraps and craft back up.
A Block of Leather to keep it all in.
